Jon Husted

Republican candidate for United States Senate (Unexpired Term Ending 01/03/2029), Ohio · Incumbent

U.S. Senator from Ohio (appointed incumbent)

Jon Husted is a Republican who has represented Ohio in the U.S. Senate since January 2025, when Governor Mike DeWine appointed him to the seat JD Vance left after becoming Vice President. He served earlier as Ohio Lieutenant Governor, Secretary of State, and Speaker of the Ohio House. He is running in the November 3, 2026 special election for the rest of the term, which ends January 3, 2029.

Where Husted stands

Prescription drug costs
Says Americans are "getting ripped off by the drug companies" because Congress won't hold them accountable, and pledges to hold drug companies accountable.
Data centers and utility rates
Introduced the Ratepayer Protection Act, which would require states to consider setting standards on how data center electricity costs affect other ratepayers.
Cost of living / energy
Says rolling back energy regulations will lower costs for everyday Americans.
Taxes and business costs
Points to his record as Ohio House Speaker, when he helped pass a budget with what was then the state's largest income tax cut, and to his work as Secretary of State lowering business costs.

Background

  • U.S. Senator from Ohio, appointed January 2025–present
  • Lieutenant Governor of Ohio, 2019–2025
  • Ohio Secretary of State, 2011–2019
  • Ohio State Senator, 2009–2010
  • Speaker of the Ohio House of Representatives, 2005–2008; Ohio House member from 2001
  • Education: University of Dayton (B.A., M.A.)
